findings.title: Preserve the idempotency key across retries
findings.trigger: The server commits a charge but its response times out and the client retries.
findings.impact: The retry uses a new idempotency key and can submit a second charge.
findings.change: In `src/retry-policy.ts`, reuse one idempotency key across every attempt for the same logical charge.

questions.title: Must retries preserve request order?
questions.evidence: The new queue retries at the tail, while existing callers consume it as FIFO. The issue, tests, and history do not establish whether reordering is allowed.
questions.why_it_matters: The answer determines whether this is a merge-blocking regression.
questions.answer: Confirm whether retry order is part of the contract; the maintainer answer settles whether the candidate should re-open as a finding.

observations.fact: The first configuration sentence covers same-shard re-points more broadly than the implementation does.

prior_items.note: The queue now blocks when full.
prior_items.reply: Fixed: a full queue now blocks instead of dropping the charge.
